title: 第二十三章 并非方拙唐氏药堂第二十四章 唐氏少主唐门旧事
slug: 红楼我乃宗师贾环当登基为帝
lines: 贾环解释着血迹滴落的迹象。
当时凶手与方拙搏斗，占据优势，但明显也受了伤，现场上可以看出来，两个人有搏斗的痕迹。
凶手要比方拙高出来很多。
跟现在躺在地上这个无头的方拙一样！
周旭点了点头，道：“方拙确实比我高，也就是凶手跟方拙的身高差不多？”
“没错，现在能看出这一点，马癞，去把周围的人都喊来，问一下，昨晚，他们有听到什么动静没？”
从尸体的情况上看，死于昨夜，大概时间跟周旭拜访的时间差不多。
周旭暗自庆幸能被排除嫌疑。
越是查看周围的情况，越是心惊胆战。
时间跟他来找方拙几乎就重叠了。
换句话说，他当时找完方拙，前脚出门，后脚方拙就死了？
“不对不对？”
贾环继续在尸体身上翻看。
心中有一股更加不对劲的感觉。
“怎么了头？”
几个人都凑了过来。
刚才贾环评估尸体是在四个时辰前，是因为四个时辰前周旭见过方拙。
可现在仔细再看下去，发现尸体死亡时间可能更早。
“尸体可能死亡时间在五个时辰，甚至六个时辰！”
“不可能！”
周旭当即说出话来。
这绝对不可能。
四个时辰前，他就见到方拙，当时看的真真的，还在他家中喝了茶，顺手拿走了很多暗器，当时方拙还很生气。
可是现在贾环说方拙的死亡时间在五个时辰甚至六个时辰，那就对不上了。
“这是怎么回事？”霍老不由发出疑惑。
贾环也是深锁眉头。
“若你四个时辰前，见到的真是方拙，那眼前这个尸体，可能就不是方拙！”
一言甫毕。
四下寂然！
眼前的“方拙”不是方拙。
那真的方拙在哪里？
贾环相信自己的判断没错，痕迹追踪中，判断一个尸体死亡时间，还是能做到了。
若是再升几品上去，利用痕迹追踪，能判断出的东西，也会更多。
顿时一团迷雾缭绕在众人周边。
马癞很快把两边的邻居喊来。
他们也是很懵，完全不知道怎么回事。
等到进来一看，一个个吓傻了，谁能想到方拙竟会死在家中。
平常方拙就是一个独来独往的人。
两边的邻居很少走动，有什么事，也是去往铁匠铺，要些材料之类的。
大家知道这么一个人，但却很少接触。
周旭点头道：“确实是如此，平常方拙很少跟人接触，他的性格有些跟别人不一样，我跟他认识，也是因为几年前一桩案子，当时有人用了暗器，最后找到了方拙，他看出暗器出自唐氏阁，众人才有线索。”
content_en:
Jia Huan explained the signs of blood dripping.
At that time, the murderer fought with Fang Zhuo and had the upper hand, but he was obviously injured. It could be seen at the scene that there were signs of a struggle between the two people.
The murderer is much taller than Fang Zhuo.
Just like the headless Fang Zhuo lying on the ground now!
Zhou Xu nodded and said, "Fang Zhuo is indeed taller than me. Does that mean the murderer is about the same height as Fang Zhuo?"
"Yes, you can see this now. Ma Lei, go and call the people around you and ask them, did they hear anything last night?"
Judging from the condition of the body, he died last night, probably around the same time as Zhou Xu visited.
Zhou Xu was secretly glad that he could be eliminated as a suspect.
The more he looked at his surroundings, the more frightened he became.
The time almost overlapped with his visit to Fang Zhuo.
In other words, after he finished looking for Fang Zhuo, he went out with his front foot, and Fang Zhuo died after his back foot?
"Isn't that right?"
Jia Huan continued to look through the body.
There was a feeling in my heart that something was even more wrong.
"What's wrong?"
Several people came over.
Just now, Jia Huan assessed the corpse four hours ago because Zhou Xu had seen Fang Zhuo four hours ago.
But now if we look carefully, we can see that the body may have died earlier.
"The corpse may have been dead for five hours, or even six hours!"
"Impossible!"
Zhou Xu spoke immediately.
This is absolutely impossible.
Four hours ago, he met Fang Zhuo. At that time, he saw Fang Zhuo really well. He drank tea at his house and took away many hidden weapons. Fang Zhuo was still very angry at that time.
But now Jia Huan said that Fang Zhuo's death time was five hours or even six hours, which is not correct.
"What's going on?" Mr. Huo couldn't help but wonder.
Jia Huan also frowned deeply.
"If what you saw four hours ago was really Fang Zhuo, then the corpse in front of you might not be Fang Zhuo!"
All in one word.
Silence everywhere!
The "Fang Zhuo" in front of me is not Fang Zhuo.
So where is the real clumsiness?
Jia Huan believed that his judgment was correct. During trace tracing, he could still determine the time of death of a corpse.
If you go up a few more levels and use trace tracking, you can determine more things.
Suddenly a mist surrounded everyone.
Ma Lei quickly called the neighbors on both sides.
They were also confused and had no idea what was going on.
When they came in and took a look, everyone was shocked. Who would have thought that Fang Zhuo would die at home.
Fang Zhuo is usually a loner.
The neighbors on both sides rarely move around. If something happens, they go to the blacksmith shop to ask for some materials.
Everyone knows such a person, but rarely comes into contact with him.
Zhou Xu nodded and said, "That's true. Fang Zhuo rarely interacts with people. His personality is a little different from others. I know him because of a case a few years ago. Someone used a hidden weapon. Finally, Fang Zhuo was found. He saw that the hidden weapon came from Tang's Pavilion, and everyone had clues."
